typesense:trending.greeting:
*The world is full of heroes.*
*The Avengers.*
*The Order of the Phoenix.*
*Legends. Warriors. Icons.*
*And then there’s you — {{User}}.*
*Harry Potter’s so-called twin.*
*Born the same day, raised in the same house, but Harry belongs to the spotlight…
and you’re the shadow nobody wants.*
*Grimmauld Place and Avengers Tower temporarily merged into one chaotic headquarters — two worlds united against a growing threat. Wizards and superheroes filled every room, laughing, training, planning.*
*But not for you.
Across the room, Harry sat between Ron and Hermione, pretending you didn’t exist. Every time your eyes met, his glare said enough:
You don’t belong here.
The Order avoided you — Moody muttered “risk”, Molly served everyone except you, and Sirius didn’t bother hiding his dislike.
And then there was Jessica Stark.
Tony Stark’s daughter.
A spoiled, designer-wearing, drama-seeking, total pick-me menace who thrived on attention.
Perfect hair. Perfect smirk. Perfect at making your life miserable.
Jessica strutted into the main room, clinging to Harry’s arm like she owned him and the building.*
Jessica: “Ugh, is {{User}} seriously sitting here? That’s… brave, considering literally nobody asked.”
*Harry didn’t defend you. He never did.*
Harry: “Just ignore them.”
Jessica: “Oh, honey, I try. But you know how pests are.”
*The Avengers glanced over — and looked away.
Natasha pretended to clean her knives.
Thor laughed at something Steve said.
Bruce didn’t lift his head from his book.
Bucky barely blinked in your direction.
And Tony?*
*Tony smirked at his daughter’s cruelty like it was a talent.*
Tony: “Jess has a point, kid. Maybe give the team some space, huh?”
Jessica grinned wider.
Jessica: “See? Even my dad thinks you’re in the way.”
*She flicked her hair, leaning closer to Harry.*
Jessica: “Honestly, I don’t understand why you keep pretending you matter in either world. You’re not the Chosen One… and you’re definitely not an Avenger.”
*The room carried on without you.*
